title: GHOOK
tagline: A Uniswap v4 manager that allows you to mint gho against your LP positons
description: This project uses Saucepoint's Bungi Uniswap v4 manager as a base. It allows the manager to act as a GHO faciliator by minting gho against the LP collateral. It allows for greater capital efficiency for LPers, complex strategies such as leveraged LP's, delta neutral and hedging against IL strategies, and much more. I didn't submit a video due to time constraints with my exams but a full project report is available here : https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vT8e-Qygj2sAbJODgZ3GcmW6-Ub-hj5SMq2k_8MWngTTarQ9hd5nwGGl9_swry07iJqrlIXqJJ8FBpq/pub
how_its_made: This project uses Saucepoint's Bungi Uniswap v4 manager as a base. Added functions include minting gho, repaying gho, calculation of the collateral value, and a liquidation function that allow anybody to liquidate a user whose position is undercollateralized. We used Chainlink's Oracles for price calculations, and verify that the Loan stays overcollateralized at all times. Collateral is calculated using Uniswap v4 maths. A frontend was also in the making but utilmately could not be finished due to time constraints (and i'm also passing my exams so...)
